chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
You may perform wudu (ablution) from stagnant water, unless you find other water besides it; then avoid it.

key_terms.الْمَاءِ الْآجِنِ: stagnant or changed water being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.فَتَنَزَّهْ عَنْهُ: then avoid it and keep away from using it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform wudu (ablution) with stagnant water in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding using stagnant water for wudu (ablution). It indicates that wudu (ablution) with such water is permissible, but if other water is available, it is preferable to avoid using it.
